description: C54 — 双方协调竞速，谁先完成谁占优

intro.popup_en:
Piece Coordination, Practice 9
A quiet Giuoco Pianissimo position becomes a coordination race. White gradually coordinates with Re1 and a knight reroute.
intro.popup:
子力协调第9局
焦科钢琴态势体：小意大利亚（慢节奏）
白方通过Re1+马跨路渐进完成协调竞速

outro.popup_en: Summary: complete coordination creates an advantage. Re1 and the knight's arrival on d4 establish a well-timed grip on the center.
outro.popup:
总结：协调完整就是优势
Re1加上马Nxd4占领中心，不错的协调步调！

moves.popup: e4开局
moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game and claims the center.

moves.popup: e5对称
moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central advance.

moves.popup:
Nf3第1马
控制e5/d4
moves.popup_en: Nf3 develops the first knight and controls e5 and d4.

moves.popup: Nc6保护e5
moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops and defends e5.

moves.popup:
Bc4意大利开局
激活：象瞄准f7
计划：准备c3+d3稳健体系
moves.popup_en: Bc4 enters the Italian Game, targeting f7 and preparing the solid c3-d3 setup.

moves.popup:
Bc5对称
黑方象瞄准f2
moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 mirrors White's development and targets f2.

moves.popup:
d3稳健推进！
激活：开放c1象的斜线
协调：d3是小意大利亚体系的核心
计划：带出双马，然后易位、车激活、后出场
moves.popup_en: d3 is a solid move that opens the c1-bishop's diagonal. In the Giuoco Pianissimo plan, White develops both knights, castles, activates a rook, and only then brings the queen into play.

moves.popup:
Nf6黑方第2马！
攻击e4
moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's second knight and attacks e4.

moves.popup:
c3准备d4！
激活：为d4进一步奠基
协调：c3+d3双兵山，马绎路更有价值
moves.popup_en: c3 prepares d4. Together, the c3 and d3 pawns support the center and give the knights useful routes.

moves.popup: d6黑方守中心
moves.popup_en: ...d6 reinforces Black's center.

moves.popup:
Nbd2第2马出动！
激活：b1马出动
协调：Nf3+Nd2双马控制中心
计划：Nd2将来跨路：f1→e3，进入中心！
moves.popup_en: Nbd2 develops the b1-knight. Along with Nf3, it supports the center and may reroute via f1 to e3.

moves.popup:
O-O黑方易位
国王进安全区
moves.popup_en: ...O-O brings Black's king to safety.

moves.popup:
O-O白方易位！
激活：Rf1激活
协调：易位后下一步Re1，车控e列
计划：易位完成，全力参与中心大战
moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles and activates the rook on f1. Re1 can follow to control the e-file and join the central struggle.

moves.popup:
Be6黑方象出动
黑方轻子继续发展
moves.popup_en: ...Be6 develops another black minor piece.

moves.popup:
Bb3象调整！
激活：Bb3控制a2-g8实用斜线
协调：Bb3+Nd2+Nf3三子投射中心
moves.popup_en: Bb3 adjusts the bishop to a useful a2-g8 diagonal. Together with Nd2 and Nf3, it adds pressure toward the center.

moves.popup:
Bxb3黑方换象
黑方主动换掉白方Bb3
moves.popup_en: ...Bxb3 exchanges Black's bishop for the white bishop on b3.

moves.popup:
axb3 a兵回吃！
激活：a列半开放
协调：Ra1将可动用
moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures with the a-pawn, leaving a semi-open a-file that White's rook may use.

moves.popup: a6黑方展开后翼
moves.popup_en: ...a6 prepares Black's queenside expansion.

moves.popup:
Re1！车激活！！
激活：Re1控制e列
协调：Re1（车）+Nf3（马）+Nd2（马）三子联动！
计划：e列控制就位，步步推进协调！
moves.popup_en: Re1! White activates the rook on the e-file. Re1, Nf3, and Nd2 now work together as White continues coordinating the pieces.

moves.popup:
Ne7黑方马调整
黑方准备马跨路
moves.popup_en: ...Ne7 repositions the knight and prepares a reroute.

moves.popup:
Nf1！马开始跨路旅行！
激活：Nd2移到f1
路径：d2→f1→e3，进入中心！
计划：马将到达最佳格！
moves.popup_en: Nf1 begins the knight's reroute from d2. The plan is d2-f1-e3, bringing the knight toward a strong central square.

moves.popup:
Ng6黑方马进入王翼！
黑方马也向王翼发起威胁
moves.popup_en: ...Ng6 brings Black's knight toward the kingside, where it may create threats.

moves.popup:
Ne3！马到达目标！
激活：f1马抵达e3中心强格！
协调：Ne3（控制d5/f5/c4）+Re1（控e列）+Nf3（已就位）
✅ 三子协调联合开歌！
moves.popup_en: Ne3! The knight reaches its target square, controlling d5, f5, and c4. It joins Re1 and Nf3 in a coordinated central setup.

moves.popup:
Nh5黑方马向g3/f4
黑方马在王翼寻找机会
moves.popup_en: ...Nh5 heads toward g3 or f4 as Black looks for kingside opportunities.

moves.popup:
d4！中心爆发！
激活：d4打开中心
协调：Ne3+Nf3两马就待等d4开放
计划：d4后，Nxd4卡马中心！
moves.popup_en: d4! White opens the center when both knights are ready to respond. After the exchange, Nxd4 can place a knight on a powerful central square.

moves.popup:
exd4黑方吃兵
黑方开放中心
moves.popup_en: ...exd4 captures and opens the center.

moves.popup:
Nxd4！！马占领中心！
激活：Nf3跳入d4，占领中心强格
协调终结态：
♙ Nxd4（马占领d4）
♕ Ne3（马精准占据e3）
♜ Re1（车控e列）
♙ c3+d3（马色格兵为主，马备最适）
✅ 先完成马+车协调的一方就占中心优势！
moves.popup_en: Nxd4!! The knight from f3 occupies a strong central square. White's knights on d4 and e3 coordinate with Re1 on the e-file, supported by the c3 and d3 pawns. The side that coordinates its knights and rook first gains control of the center.
